use_case_summary: Mid-market SaaS product team (B2B search) building a retrieval+rerank pipeline. Primary objective is to increase relevance (precision@10) for enterprise customers while keeping interactive latency acceptable. Offline nightly re-ranking for long-tail content also required.
requirements_summary: Targets: P@10 >= 0.8 (from baseline 0.62), rerank P95 latency <= 150ms for in-app queries, throughput ~25–50 qps steady-state, support for offline batch scoring (10k+ docs/night), SSO + SOC2 + KMS, EU data residency for subset, 12 months audit log retention. Cost sensitivity: wants 20–30% unit-cost savings through batching/quantization before buying Dedicated.
